approval: User message 'lance la campagne' after research_design.md and data_audit.md. The four open decisions are taken as proposed: (1) primary book = the 6 sleeves listed by the user (incl. mnq_atr_trend_flip), secondary = active lock eight_sleeve_equal_contract_reference_20261103; (2) H1 kept on MNQ and MGC, at best CONDITIONAL PASS there because their OOS was already read for the VWAP-extension family; (3) USD sizing = 100 USD risk per trade, 1 to 5 contracts; (4) thresholds, windows and grids of research_design.md unchanged.
disclosure_before_freeze: No return following any R1 signal was computed before this freeze. audit_data.py and audit_thresholds.py computed coverage, volume profiles, unsigned deviations and trigger frequencies only.

Prior results seen: mean_reversion_cross_asset_20261006 rejected vwap_extension (|close-VWAP|/ATR14 5m), range_extreme and consecutive_exhaustion on MNQ, MGC, MES, M2K, NQ, MBT; its event study showed continuation, not reversion, after VWAP extensions; its OOS (MNQ from 2024-02-23, MGC from 2023-03-17) was read for that family.
Thresholds were chosen from unsigned trigger frequencies (audit/threshold_frequencies.csv) and the lunch window from the volume profile (audit/activity_profile.csv).

MES.stage_rule: run only if a MNQ or MGC central cell passes the IS gate

common.bars: one-minute bars stamped at bar start, America/New_York; session grid from session start to session end
common.eligible_session: at least 90 % of session minutes present; not among the pre_roll_excluded_sessions sessions before an instrument_id change; sigma_day and sigma5 available
common.signal_bars: 5-minute bars made of minutes [5b, 5b+4] of the session grid; a signal at bar b is known at the close of minute 5b+4
common.entry_minute: e = 5b+5; entries allowed for 30 <= e <= session_minutes - 30 and e < forced_exit; lunch tests use their own window
common.entry_fill: open of minute e + 1 tick against the position; skipped if that open is missing
common.stop_fill: first minute j >= e whose low (long) or high (short) reaches the stop; fill = worse of stop and open of j, plus 1 tick
common.target_fill: limit at the target level; filled at the level in the first minute that trades 1 tick beyond it; moving VWAP target at minute j = VWAP at the close of minute j-1
common.time_exit: close of the last allowed minute minus/plus 1 tick
common.skip_rules: no trade if the entry fill is already at or beyond the target, or if the stop is not on the losing side of the entry
common.position_rule: one position at a time per instrument and test; a candidate whose entry minute is not after the previous exit minute in the same session is dropped
common.rearm: after a signal on one side, that side fires again only after the score has come back inside threshold minus hysteresis (0.5 for z and X scores, 0.05 for the range position)
common.costs: commission 1.25 USD per side plus the slippage above
common.vwap: cumulative sum(typical * volume) / cumulative volume from session start, typical = (high + low + close) / 3
common.sigma_vwap: sqrt(cumulative sum(volume * typical^2) / cumulative volume - VWAP^2)
common.sigma_day: std of log(session close / session open) over the 20 previous complete sessions, at least 15
common.sigma5: root mean square of intra-session 5-minute log returns over the 20 previous complete sessions
common.efficiency_ratio: |close5_b - session open| / sum of |close5 changes| from the session open
common.unit_of_record: net USD per contract and R per trade; daily series = sum of net USD per eligible session, 0 when no trade

H2_D1.deceleration: RMS of bar returns b-1..b <= 0.5 * RMS of bar returns b-5..b-2
H2_D1.volume_fade: mean volume of bars b-1..b <= mean volume of bars b-5..b-2
H2_D1.stop: extreme of bars b-5..b plus 1 tick beyond, at least 0.5 * sigma5 * sqrt(6) * price from the entry

H2_D2.deceleration: bar b return of opposite sign to X or zero, and bar b makes no new extreme of bars b-5..b-1

H3_VWAP.low_volume: volume of bars b-5..b <= median of the same bars over the 20 previous eligible sessions (at least 15)

H3_RANGE.score: P - 0.5, P = (close5 - session low) / (session high - session low), high/low of bars 0..b

direction: contrarian: short when the score is above the threshold, long when below minus the threshold

is_gate_per_test_and_instrument_on_the_c.G1: mean daily net USD > 0, Newey-West t >= 2.0, and Holm-adjusted one-sided p <= 0.05 over the 18 tests (6 tests x MNQ, MGC, MCL)
is_gate_per_test_and_instrument_on_the_c.G2: at least 2/3 of the test's grid cells with positive IS net USD, and every immediate neighbour of the central cell positive
is_gate_per_test_and_instrument_on_the_c.G3: net USD > 0 with costs doubled and with entry one minute later
is_gate_per_test_and_instrument_on_the_c.G4: more than half of IS calendar years positive, and no year above 50 % of the IS net total
is_gate_per_test_and_instrument_on_the_c.G5: long and short net both > 0, or the non-positive side has gross >= 0
is_gate_per_test_and_instrument_on_the_c.G6: placebo: 1000 draws; each real trade moved to a random eligible session of the same period, same half-hour bucket, same side, same fractional stop and target distances; p = share of draws with mean net R >= the real-timing mean net R under the same fixed geometry; p <= 0.05; and the mirrored opposite-direction trades have mean net R < 0
is_gate_per_test_and_instrument_on_the_c.G7: PRE proxy (NQ for MNQ, CL for MCL) net USD > 0 with Newey-West t >= 1.0; MGC has no PRE and uses EXT net USD > 0
is_gate_per_test_and_instrument_on_the_c.if_pass: the user is asked before OOS is read

oos_verdict: mean daily net > 0 with t >= 1.0 and OOS mean R per trade >= 50 % of IS mean R per trade
diagnostics_not_gated: volatility terciles (VIX previous close for MNQ/NQ, sigma_day vs past 252 sessions otherwise)
cost x2 and +1 tick per side
CSCV PBO over the 42 cells per instrument, 12 blocks
walk-forward of the neighbourhood-smoothed-Sharpe selection rule, expanding by calendar year
rolling 252-session mean of the central cell
diversification: only for a candidate that passes the OOS verdict; books and sizing as in research_design.md section 7
prohibitions: no cell other than the central one is a candidate
no threshold, window, exit or filter changed after the freeze
no OOS before the IS gate and the user's approval
